test_inputs.explanation: The only concrete value observed in the execution trace was the Admin Categories URL (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_category/). No specific form inputs were recorded, so the remaining required fields (parent_category_name and name) and optional metadata were supplied as realistic, replayable test values: 'Default Category' is the typical root parent shown in Magento, a descriptive category name and matching url_key are provided, and active/include flags plus description/meta fields are set to standard test values to allow a successful replay of the category-creation flow.
